commit_message:
[Flow] Fold chained tensor.slice ops (#24628)

This PR Adds a canonicalization pattern for `flow.tensor.slice` that
folds only when the producer of the slice source is also a
`flow.tensor.slice`.

**Example :**

%producer = flow.tensor.slice %src[producer_start for producer_length]
%consumer = flow.tensor.slice %producer[consumer_start for
consumer_length]

**Canonicalizes to :**

%consumer = flow.tensor.slice %src[producer_start + consumer_start ] for
consumer_length
